content.text:
**What I'd tell a colleague:** I came away with no answer. It's a directory, not a comparison. No page I saw gives a per-trade fee, a monthly custody fee (דמי משמרת) or an FX conversion rate. All it shows per bank is "תעריפון מ־01.10.2026". To get a number I'd have to open each company one at a time. I'm fairly sure of that, because the four screens I had are all lists and link arrows. I closed the tab around the second screen.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. **"מה חברה מציעה לי", the "בתי השקעות" list.** I scanned each company's product tags looking for "חשבון ניירות ערך". Only IBI, Altshuler, the Phoenix, Meitav, Interactive Israel and Interactive Brokers have that tag. So for opening a trading account, the rest of the list is noise.
2. **"בנקים ובתי השקעות נוספים".** These are the banks plus Pepper, One Zero and Pessagot. Each row gives only a type and a fee-schedule date. Yerushalayim, Mizrahi and Pessagot say "ללא תאריך פרסום", so presumably no fee schedule was found for them. Still not one number.
3. **A collapsed list further down:** ריט 1, BlackRock, Invesco, iShares, MSCI, Nasdaq, S&P Dow Jones Indices. I didn't open it, because nothing on it was about costs.
4. **Footer.** It says "אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק", and the data was last checked 07.11.2026. That's good: no broker is pushing itself up top.

**What I skipped:** the gap between screenshots 1 and 2, which looked like an insurance-company section. Also the "לפי מוצר" tab, the search box, the "לא נכלל" block and the "כל הרשומות" fold.

**What bugged me:**
- **The "בתי השקעות" heading doesn't match the list under it.** Interactive Brokers is a foreign broker, not an investment house. קסם is a fund brand that offers only "קרנות סל · קרנות מחקות", and you can't open an account with it. Harel, Migdal and the Phoenix come across mostly as insurers, carrying pension and gemel tags. If the heading is wrong about those rows, I don't trust the rest of the grouping.
- **The issuers list mixes kinds.** MSCI, Nasdaq and S&P DJI build indices; they don't sell funds. BlackRock and iShares are listed as two separate entries, though iShares is BlackRock's brand. ריט 1 is a single REIT company. I couldn't see that list's heading, so I can't say what it promised.
- **Not one cost figure in four screens.** I gave it about a minute.

findings.what: No cost numbers anywhere on the overview. Banks show only a fee-schedule date, so nothing can be compared at a glance.

The heading 'בתי השקעות' covers a foreign broker (Interactive Brokers), a fund brand you can't open an account with (קסם: only 'קרנות סל · קרנות מחקות'), and companies that are mostly insurers (הראל, מגדל, הפניקס). That makes me doubt the grouping as a whole.
Index providers (MSCI, Nasdaq, S&P Dow Jones Indices) sit in the same list as fund managers, with BlackRock and its iShares brand as separate entries and a single REIT company (ריט 1) among them.
For someone who wants a trading account, most rows are irrelevant: only a handful have 'חשבון ניירות ערך', and there's no filter for that on this view.
Three entries have no fee-schedule date ('ללא תאריך פרסום'), including Mizrahi and Pessagot.
